title: Empty state
summary: What a list, a panel or a page says when it has nothing to show: no data, the first time, nothing found, no access, an error, no connection or work being prepared, with an icon, a real heading, a sentence and actions.

template.description: Template variant name for SfBaseElement external templates.

root-class.description: Classes added to the root element the component draws.

root-style.description: Inline style declarations set on the root element the component draws, custom properties included.

kind.description: The reason, which picks the default icon, tone, title and text: first-use offers a primary «Создать» (id create), error and offline «Повторить» (id retry), offline also retries by itself when the network returns, and processing draws a spinner in the icon's circle for work that finishes without the person, or with value a ring with the percentage.

size.description: 1/3 is always the inline form; 1/2 inside a table or panel, 2 for a whole page: the icon, title role, text and gaps follow.

icon.description: The section's icon (the one of its menu entry) for no-data and first-use, inbox without one; for nothing-found by filters pass filter_alt_off. The other reasons keep their own glyph unless this is set.

value.description: processing only: the share done in per cent, 0 to 100 (clamped, whole). Set, the circle is an sf-progress-ring with the percentage; unset, the spinner turns. The inline form keeps the spinner. Provisional name (C120 (2) names no attribute).

heading-level.description: The title's outline level; its look follows the size.

layout.description: inline: one line for a list inside a menu, a dropdown or a search -- a small icon, the words and at most one link action, no heading.

live.description: auto: nothing-found and error are a polite status, the others say nothing; alert: an error the person caused; off: the host announces it.

expressive.description: The decorative level (owner decision C91, level 2): one soft circle of the primary colour behind the icon of a whole-page state (size 2) for no-data and nothing-found; a list, a table or a card stays plain. Off by default, a strict state; data-sf-style="expressive" on the root or a container turns it on for every state under it, and data-sf-style="strict" turns it off again.

actions.description: Set as a property: [{id, text, appearance}], drawn at the component's size; each raises sf-empty-state-action {id}. Slot `actions` takes the host's own buttons instead. Unset: error and offline offer retry, first-use a primary create.

sf-empty-state-action.summary: The person pressed one of the actions (retry for an error or offline without actions of their own, create for first-use); for offline also sent by itself with auto: true when the window's online event says the network is back.

forbidden_client_responsibilities: saving the width on a server

accessibility.focus: The block title is a heading at heading-level; the inline form has no heading. With live=auto nothing-found, error, offline and processing are announced politely (role=status), the others are not; live=alert makes it an alert, live=off silent. The icon and the processing spinner are decorative; the processing ring (value set) is a progressbar named «Готово» with the share as its value; the actions are ordinary buttons in the tab order. Inside a listbox or menu, place it outside the list element so it is never an item.

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-empty-state wherever a list, panel or page has nothing to show, choosing the kind for the reason; processing for work that finishes later without the person (minutes), not for a load the person waits for.
do_not: Do not copy generated ui-smart code
Do not show an empty state while data is still loading; that is the skeleton's
Do not hand-build an empty message with a paragraph
Do not use processing for a wait of seconds; that is sf-skeleton, sf-spinner or a progress bar
